params.name: mask
params.description: Receives the resulting comparison mask picture

overloads.semanticRole: Pixel-by-pixel compares the dimensions and contents of two pictures and produces a visual diff mask.

constraints: If dimensions differ, returns False and mask is a blank picture.
If dimensions match but contents differ, returns False and mask is a black-on-white pixel-diff picture (mismatched pixels appear white on black).
If the pictures are identical, returns True and mask is entirely black.
Sets the OK system variable to 0 if a picture is uninitialized (blank), otherwise 1.
